product.outcome: Finish a short Portuguese lesson, review fading words, and read a story at the right level.

users.who: A Portuguese learner studying for ten minutes on a phone, then reading a graded story on a tablet or laptop.

capabilities.note: The Portuguese path and graded stories are authored course content.
Answers are checked against authored lesson answers; no conversation agent is implied.
Lesson completion, review strength and reading position require acknowledgement.
Listening prompts have bundled course audio.
Study goal and translation preferences persist per learner.
Opted-in learners receive a weekly summary of acknowledged progress.
Opted-in reminders use the saved review schedule.
Pronunciation scoring is unavailable; speaking lessons have text prompts, not microphone or scoring controls.

learnReady.label: Course path
learnReady.rule: Lead with the unfinished weights-and-quantities lesson; completed lessons stay marked and future units retain their order.

learnLoading.label: Loading course
learnLoading.rule: Keep the heading and navigation while reserving the path; do not expose an unconfirmed Continue target.

learnEmpty.label: First lesson
learnEmpty.rule: No progress exists yet; offer the first Portuguese lesson, not a course-selection capability.

learnFailed.label: Course unavailable
learnFailed.rule: Keep navigation and reload the unavailable path without changing saved progress.

learnLongContent.label: Long lesson names
learnLongContent.rule: Wrap lesson and unit titles independently without hiding unit numbers or progress.

learnUpdated.label: Progress updated
learnUpdated.rule: Show the completed listening lesson and next unfinished lesson after acknowledgement.

lessonReady.label: Answering
lessonReady.rule: Show the authored market dialogue and answer input; checking an answer is not messaging a person.

lessonLoading.label: Loading lesson
lessonLoading.rule: Keep identity and return route; hide answer and audio controls until the prompt is loaded.

lessonEmpty.label: Lesson unavailable
lessonEmpty.rule: Return to Learn when a lesson is removed; do not create a blank chat.

lessonFailed.label: Prompt unavailable
lessonFailed.rule: Preserve any entered answer and reload the unavailable prompt.

lessonLongContent.label: Long dialogue
lessonLongContent.rule: Wrap the complete Portuguese prompt; keep the answer input after its prompt in reading order.

lessonChecking.label: Checking answer
lessonChecking.rule: Retain the submitted answer and prevent another check while its result is pending.

lessonCorrect.label: Answer accepted
lessonCorrect.rule: Mark this answer correct and allow the next prompt; completion still requires all answers.

lessonRetry.label: Answer needs revision
lessonRetry.rule: Keep the answer editable; no XP is awarded for a rejected answer.

lessonSaving.label: Saving completion
lessonSaving.rule: Keep the final answer visible while course progress is being saved.

lessonCompleted.label: Lesson complete
lessonCompleted.rule: After acknowledgement show earned XP and return to the updated course path.

lessonSaveFailed.label: Completion not saved
lessonSaveFailed.rule: Keep accepted answers and retry only the progress save, not the whole lesson.

lessonListening.label: Listening prompt
lessonListening.rule: Show the weights-and-quantities prompt with audio; no speech-scoring control is offered.

practiceReady.label: Review schedule
practiceReady.rule: Show due dates and strengths; the fading and weak words are due today.

practiceLoading.label: Loading vocabulary
practiceLoading.rule: Withhold Review now until due vocabulary is confirmed.

practiceEmpty.label: Nothing due
practiceEmpty.rule: Explain that no review is due and return to the course path.

practiceFailed.label: Schedule unavailable
practiceFailed.rule: Retry the schedule fetch without resetting word strength.

practiceLongContent.label: Long vocabulary
practiceLongContent.rule: Wrap the entire expression and explanation without ellipses.

practiceReviewed.label: Review saved
practiceReviewed.rule: Show reviewed words as strong with acknowledged next-review dates.

libraryReady.label: Graded stories
libraryReady.rule: Open the A2 baker story at its saved section.

libraryLoading.label: Loading stories
libraryLoading.rule: Keep the heading while fetching the graded catalog.

libraryEmpty.label: No matching stories
libraryEmpty.rule: Reset the level filter rather than claiming a story can be created.

libraryFailed.label: Library unavailable
libraryFailed.rule: Reload the catalog without losing course progress.

libraryLongContent.label: Long story title
libraryLongContent.rule: Wrap the full story title and keep its level visible.

storyReady.label: Reading
storyReady.rule: Restore section one of the A2 baker story; translation is hidden until requested.

storyLoading.label: Loading story
storyLoading.rule: Retain the Library return route; progress is hidden until the section arrives.

storyEmpty.label: Story unavailable
storyEmpty.rule: Offer the Library rather than a nonfunctional Next section action.

storyFailed.label: Story load failed
storyFailed.rule: Keep saved position and retry loading the same story.

storyLongContent.label: Long story
storyLongContent.rule: Reflow at a readable measure; keep vocabulary beside the selected sentence.

storySaving.label: Saving reading position
storySaving.rule: Retain the current section while waiting for save acknowledgement.

storyCompleted.label: Reading saved
storyCompleted.rule: The final section is acknowledged; offer another story and retain the saved position.

storySaveFailed.label: Position not saved
storySaveFailed.rule: Retry saving the visible section without advancing the story.

storyWordSaving.label: Saving vocabulary
storyWordSaving.rule: Keep the selected meaning open until vocabulary is saved.

storyWordSaved.label: Vocabulary saved
storyWordSaved.rule: Mark the word as saved to practice only after acknowledgement.

storyWordFailed.label: Vocabulary not saved
storyWordFailed.rule: Retain the selected meaning and retry its save without closing the story.

wordListDraft.label: List draft
wordListDraft.rule: Edit collection name and description; select saved vocabulary rather than editing preferences.

wordListSaving.label: Saving list
wordListSaving.rule: Retain the name, description and vocabulary while preventing duplicate creation.

wordListSaved.label: List saved
wordListSaved.rule: Show acknowledged list identity and word count with a route to Practice.

wordListFailed.label: List not saved
wordListFailed.rule: Retain the entire draft and retry the same save.

wordListLongContent.label: Long list draft
wordListLongContent.rule: Keep the full learner-authored name and description editable.

settingsReady.label: Study preferences
settingsReady.rule: Daily goal, reminder opt-in and translations require an explicit save.

settingsSaving.label: Saving study preferences
settingsSaving.rule: Keep controls visible; disable duplicate saves until acknowledged.

settingsSaved.label: Study preferences saved
settingsSaved.rule: Confirm the new goal without restarting a lesson or moving reading position.

settingsFailed.label: Preferences not saved
settingsFailed.rule: Retain the changed goal and opt-ins; offer a save retry.

landingReady.label: About Tessel
landingReady.rule: Explain course, spaced review and graded reading; the primary action enters Learn.

emailWeeklyLearningReady.label: Weekly progress digest
emailWeeklyLearningReady.rule: Summarize only acknowledged lessons and XP for the stated week; link to Learn.

pushPracticeReminderReady.label: Review due reminder
pushPracticeReminderReady.rule: Notify only opted-in learners with due vocabulary; link to the saved review schedule.

lessonCheckFailed.label: Answer check failed
lessonCheckFailed.rule: Retain the submitted answer; retry the authored answer check without saving XP or advancing the prompt.

flows.goal: Finish the next Portuguese lesson and resume from the acknowledged course path.
flows.ends: The completed lesson is marked on the path, its XP is saved, and the next unfinished lesson is available.

flows.goal: Read the baker story at the saved section and keep the final reading position.
flows.ends: Reopening the baker story restores its acknowledged final section and completion.

flows.goal: Strengthen fading words before their next review date.
flows.ends: Reviewed words become strong and their next review dates move to the saved schedule.

flows.goal: Keep an unfamiliar story word in a named practice collection.
flows.ends: The selected word appears in the saved collection and remains available for review.

binding.because: Naming a collection and selecting its words needs room beyond the narrow word-meaning panel.

flows.goal: Choose a study goal and opt into reminders without changing reading progress.
flows.ends: The daily goal, reminder opt-in and translation preference remain selected when Settings is reopened.

flows.goal: Understand Tessel and open the first useful Portuguese lesson.
flows.ends: The learner enters the course path rather than an email signup with no learning result.

flows.goal: See this week’s saved study progress and continue the next lesson.
flows.ends: The digest opens Learn at the acknowledged course path.

flows.goal: Review due vocabulary when an opted-in reminder arrives.
flows.ends: The reminder opens the due-word schedule without claiming unsaved study progress.

Earned XP and return to the path remain next to the acknowledged lesson result.
